derivation: On the p-power chain, valuation a=log(p^a)/log(p) divides primitive logarithmic coefficients by log(p), inducing metric weight 1/(log p)^2.
quadratic_result: The critical von Mangoldt source then contributes sum_{a>=1}p^-a=1/(p-1) per prime, giving harmonic-prime divergence.
adjunction: Coefficient scale 1/log(p) and Betti scale log(p) preserve unit evaluation.
Mackey_scope: Weights are balanced and ordinary degree survives within each prime-colored exponent ray, but not in fibers mixing distinct primes.
open_target: Construct the colored incomplete tensor product with an even-oscillator reference and a finite relative covariance trace.
status: canonical colorwise weighted adjunction constructed; global mixed-prime completion open
